packageRules.description: torch resolves through the pinned pytorch-cu124 index, not PyPI. A CUDA-variant bump can silently drop GPU TTS to the CPU path, which is ~160x slower (a 2-minute stage becomes ~5 hours) and raises no error. No test catches this: the suite exercises rewrite_for_tts, a pure string function that never touches torch. Requires explicit approval from the dependency dashboard.
